_comment: Source of truth for the ElevenLabs agent's non-prompt config. The agent object itself is created once via the ElevenLabs dashboard; sync-agent.ts PATCHes it to match this file on every push to main. Field names verified against https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/agents/update — see notes below on the two items that still need live-account confirmation.

first_message.default: Hi, I'm here to help with UAE services — what's going on?
first_message._why: Agent-level fallback for direct/dashboard testing where no session-start override is passed. Real per-call variety comes from the UI picking randomly from intros.json and passing it as a conversation_config_override.agent.first_message (or Conversation.startSession({ overrides }) in the JS SDK) — see intros.json. This default is just intros.json's first entry so a plain test call still gets a sensible greeting.

language._why: Speaker in the architecture diagram is explicitly English + Arabic. Auto-detect/multi-language over locking to English-only, since misdetecting an Arabic-accented English caller as needing translation (or vice versa) is worse than the small added latency.

asr._why: ElevenLabs' native real-time Scribe ASR — no custom/bolted-on STT layer, per TECH-SPEC's decision to avoid an extra round-trip inside the real-time loop. 'scribe_realtime' is the current provider value; the older 'elevenlabs' provider is being deprecated in favour of it.

llm.model: [FILL: pick from the actual dropdown in the ElevenLabs dashboard when creating the agent]
llm._why: Docs did not give a reliable enum for this field — different doc pages returned inconsistent model-version strings. Pick a low-latency conversational model from whatever the dashboard actually offers rather than guessing a string here.

tts._why: eleven_turbo_v2_5 confirmed as a valid tts.model_id value against the update-agent API reference.

turn._why: Non-native/accented speakers pause mid-sentence more than the defaults assume (turn_timeout default is 7s). 'patient' eagerness plus a slightly longer timeout avoids cutting callers off mid-thought — same intent as the earlier 'low interruption sensitivity' idea, using the real field names this time. Tune further against A's real questions once available.

_pronunciation_dictionary_note: Populate with UAE service/entity names once A's content/schema.ts and content/services/*.json land — generic ASR will mangle these.

system_tools._why: Required for the agent to switch its spoken response language mid-call when the caller switches languages — multi-language mode alone only picks the language at call start. This system tool is NOT on by default even with language.mode = multi.
system_tools._json_placement_unconfirmed: Two doc sources disagreed on where this goes in the actual PATCH body: agent.prompt.built_in_tools vs. an entry {"type": "system", "name": "language_detection"} inside agent.prompt.tools. sync-agent.ts currently emits the 'tools array' shape as the best-supported guess — verify against a GET on the real agent once one exists and correct if wrong.

_mcp_server_ids_note: Populate once C's MCP server is registered as a resource (dashboard, or a separate 'create MCP server' API call not yet made anywhere in this repo) — these hold that resource's ID, not a tool definition. mcp_server_ids vs native_mcp_server_ids: verify with C which one applies to their setup once the server exists.
_tool_ids_note: Holds the ID of the file_issue webhook tool resource (see prompt.md's 'Filing an issue' section) once D's ticket webhook exists and the tool is registered with ElevenLabs. Like mcp_server_ids, this is an ID reference, not an inline tool definition.
